nodes.description: Mapping of reflection (r) token balances per address; mutated on every transfer and on liquidity capture.
Mapping of true (t) token balances, only kept for addresses excluded from reward.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount.
Mapping marking accounts that skip tax/liquidity fee deduction.
Mapping marking accounts excluded from reflection rewards.
Total true token supply (immutable in practice, read by many paths).
Total reflection supply; reduced by fees in _reflectFee and in deliver().
Owner-settable tax fee percentage used by calculateTaxFee.
Owner-settable liquidity fee percentage used by calculateLiquidityFee.
Maximum transfer amount enforced in _transfer.
Lottery winner address; written by owner and silently auto-claimed inside transferFrom.
Flag toggled by LockToken/VaultLock enabling the 'lottery winner' transfer restriction.
Owner switch enabling automatic swap-and-liquify on transfers.
Reentrancy guard flag for the swap/liquify routine.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity addition.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address created in the constructor.
Ownable owner address; gates all onlyOwner functions.
Timestamp until which ownership is locked, set in lock() and checked in unlock().
msg.sender / _msgSender(): attacker-controlled caller address.
block.timestamp (now): used as deadline/argument for swaps and as ownership lock clock.
Public ERC20 transfer; applies lottery-winner restriction when special mode is on.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; in special mode can silently set lottery to an arbitrary recipient.
Public ERC20 approve; writes _allowances for the caller.
onlyOwner setter for the lottery address.
Private _transfer: limit checks, auto swap-and-liquify trigger, fee decision, dispatches to _tokenTransfer.
Splits contract token balance, swaps half for ETH, then adds liquidity; guarded by lockTheSwap.
Approves router and performs swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
Approves router and calls addLiquidityETH with ETH forwarded to the router.
Private dispatcher choosing standard/to-excluded/from-excluded/both-excluded transfer variants and temporarily removing fees.
Restores ownership to _previousOwner when msg.sender matches and now > _lockTime.
onlyOwner lock: stores previous owner, zeroes owner and sets _lockTime = now + time.
onlyOwner: excludes an account from reflection rewards and snapshots its t balance.
onlyOwner: recomputes _maxTxAmount from _tTotal and an arbitrary percentage.
Private view computing r/t transfer amounts, fees and liquidity amounts from fees and current rate.
Publicly callable burn of reflections for a non-excluded sender; reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
External call to the Uniswap router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with deadline and amountOutMin = 0; control leaves the contract before state settles.
External payable call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH forwarding contract ETH, with zero slippage limits.
State write inside transferFrom that assigns lottery from caller-controlled arguments (and can also auto-claim), enabling an unauthorized winner designation.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender of the ERC20 transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender in transferFrom approval deduction.
deliver() takes _msgSender() as the address whose reflections are burned.
unlock() authorization is based on msg.sender matching _previousOwner.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
unlock() compares now against _lockTime, a timestamp-dependent ownership gate.
lock() computes _lockTime as now + time, a timestamp-dependent ownership lock.
transfer() branches on the special (lottery mode) flag.
transferFrom() branches on the special (lottery mode) flag.
transfer() reads lottery to enforce the lottery-winner restriction.
transferFrom() reads and writes the lottery address.
transferFrom() deducts the caller allowance from _allowances.
approve() writes the allowance mapping.
_transfer() checks _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether fees apply.
_tokenTransfer() branches on the _isExcluded reward mapping.
_transfer() compares from against uniswapV2Pair to avoid circular liquidity.
swapTokensForEth() calls the router stored in uniswapV2Router.
addLiquidity() calls the router stored in uniswapV2Router.
_transfer() enforces the _maxTxAmount cap and uses it to clamp the contract balance.
_transfer() only triggers swap-and-liquify when swapAndLiquifyEnabled is true.
_transfer() reads the inSwapAndLiquify guard flag.
setMaxTxPercent() derives _maxTxAmount from _tTotal.
_rTotal feeds the reflection rate computation used by transfers.
_taxFee is read when computing the tax portion in _getValues.
_liquidityFee is read when computing the liquidity portion in _getValues.
_lockTime is the timestamp gate that decides whether unlock() may proceed.
lock() overwrites the _lockTime timestamp used for ownership release.
transferlottery() writes the lottery state variable.
transferFrom() may silently assign the lottery address from a caller-supplied recipient.
swapAndLiquify() sets the inSwapAndLiquify guard via the lockTheSwap modifier.
recipient parameter is consumed by transfer().
amount parameter is consumed by transfer().
sender parameter is consumed by transferFrom().
recipient parameter is consumed by transferFrom().
amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom().
from parameter drives the internal transfer checks.
to parameter drives the internal transfer checks.
amount parameter drives the internal transfer checks.
contractTokenBalance parameter is the amount split by swapAndLiquify().
half is computed and swapped inside swapAndLiquify().
otherHalf is computed and added as liquidity inside swapAndLiquify().
initialBalance snapshots ETH before the swap inside swapAndLiquify().
newBalance is the ETH delta computed inside swapAndLiquify().
tokenAmount parameter is the amount approved and swapped.
path local array is built and passed to the router swap.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and forwarded to the router.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as msg.value to addLiquidityETH.
_lottery parameter is written to the lottery state by transferlottery().
transfer() delegates the actual movement to _transfer().
transferFrom() delegates the actual movement to _transfer().
_transfer() conditionally calls swapAndLiquify() when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer() calls _tokenTransfer() to apply the correct balance variant and fees.
swapAndLiquify() calls swapTokensForEth() on the first half.
swapAndLiquify() calls addLiquidity() with the second half and the received ETH.
swapTokensForEth() performs the external router swap call.
addLiquidity() performs the external payable router call.
_tokenTransfer() variants obtain r/t amounts from _getValues().
transferlottery() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on _owner.
excludeFromReward() is gated by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent() is gated by onlyOwner.
transferFrom() executes the lottery assignment/claim state write under special mode.
The router swap calls back into the token pair/token transfer path while swapAndLiquify state is mid-update, allowing reentrancy into _transfer.

amount is only a formal parameter of transfer(); it has no independent semantics.
sender is only a formal parameter of transferFrom().
recipient is only a formal parameter of transferFrom() and feeds the lottery assignment.
amount is only a formal parameter of transferFrom().
from is only a formal parameter of the internal _transfer().
to is only a formal parameter of the internal _transfer().
amount is only a formal parameter of the internal _transfer().
contractTokenBalance is only a formal parameter of swapAndLiquify().
half is a transient local computed and consumed entirely inside swapAndLiquify().
otherHalf is a transient local computed and consumed entirely inside swapAndLiquify().
initialBalance is a transient ETH snapshot local scoped to swapAndLiquify().
newBalance is a transient ETH delta local scoped to swapAndLiquify().
tokenAmount is only a formal parameter of swapTokensForEth().
path is a transient memory array built only for the router swap call.
tokenAmount is only a formal parameter of addLiquidity().
ethAmount is only a formal parameter of addLiquidity() forwarded as msg.value.
_lottery is only a formal parameter of transferlottery() that is written to the lottery state.
